subject: general
question: Which global cybersecurity company collaborated with the Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-In) to launch the Digital Threat Report 2024 for the Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) sector in April 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**SISA**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The global cybersecurity company **SISA**, known for its forensic-driven approach, collaborated with the **Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-In)** to launch the **Digital Threat Report 2024** for the **Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI)** sector in **April 2025**.
 
• The report serves as a comprehensive guide for financial institutions to understand the evolving landscape of **cyber threats**, providing actionable insights to strengthen their **cybersecurity posture**.
 
• The collaboration highlights the importance of **Public-Private Partnerships (PPP)** in safeguarding the national **critical information infrastructure**, particularly the financial backbone of the country.
 
• Key findings in the report emphasize the rise of **sophisticated cyber-attacks** targeting digital payment gateways, mobile banking applications, and insurance databases within the **BFSI sector**.
 
• The report outlines specific **mitigation strategies** and **security frameworks** that organizations should adopt to counter threats like **ransomware**, **advanced persistent threats (APTs)**, and **AI-driven fraud**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **SISA:**
 
 
• **SISA** is a global **forensics-driven cybersecurity** company headquartered in **Bengaluru**, **India**, with a strong presence in regions like the **Middle East**, **USA**, and **South East Asia**.
 
• It is a **PCI Qualified Security Assessor (QSA)** and an authorized **Forensic Investigator (PFI)**, helping organizations comply with global standards like **PCI DSS**.
 
• The company focuses on **security compliance**, **technical audits**, and **managed detection and response (MDR)** services.
 
 
 
• **CERT-In (Indian Computer Emergency Response Team):**
 
 
• It is the national nodal agency for responding to **computer security incidents** as and when they occur, operating under the **Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)**.
 
• **CERT-In** was established in **2004** under the **Information Technology Act, 2000**.
 
• Its primary functions include **incident reporting**, issuing **advisories**, **vulnerability notes**, and conducting **cybersecurity training** for various sectors.
 
 
 
• **BFSI Sector Vulnerabilities:**
 
 
• The **BFSI sector** is a prime target for **cybercriminals** due to the high volume of **financial transactions** and sensitive **personal data** involved.
 
• Common threats include **Phishing**, **Vishing**, **Credential Stuffing**, and the use of **Deepfakes** for identity theft in the **Know Your Customer (KYC)** process.
 
• Regulations from the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** and **SEBI** mandate strict **cyber-resilience** norms for banks and intermediaries.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Emerging Threats in 2024-2025:** The report specifically identifies **Generative AI** as a double-edged sword, used by attackers to create more convincing **malware** and by defenders for **threat hunting**.
 
• **Regulatory Compliance:** Financial institutions are encouraged to align with the **Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023**, to ensure the privacy of customer information during **data breaches**.
 
• **Global Context:** Similar reports are published globally by entities like **INTERPOL** and **FS-ISAC** to track **transnational cybercrime** trends affecting the **global financial system**.
 
• **Digital Payment Security:** With the massive adoption of **UPI (Unified Payments Interface)** in **India**, the report provides a dedicated section on securing **real-time payment ecosystems**.
